title: Smithing: Iron Path
description: A simple mod that allows you to upgrade Iron tools, weapons, and armor to diamond in the exact way as netherite.
body:
A simple mod that allows you to upgrade Iron tools, weapons, and armor to diamond in the exact way as netherite.

● A mod made by Talona

● Mod created with MCreator!

New Item:
Diamond Upgrade Template

![Diamond Smithing Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31c8fd6815e37c94ff92618ae7d95e60cbdbe2dd.png)

How To Obtain:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Can Be Bought From Any Armorer Villager For At Apprentice Rank For 5 Emeralds
- Can Be Duplicated Like Normal Netherrite Templates

- ![Diamond Smithing Template Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34d6e6733b080dc02ce62ffe6456dd7c1250ad4d.png)

</details>
How To Use:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Simply Replace The Iron Boots With Whatever Iron Tool/Weapon/Armor You Desire!

![Smithing Tutorial](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dcf85e3534b5ed963773518240c5fbbb1413f5f.png)

</details>



● Config File **not** inculed.

● You are all **allowed** to use this mod in your modpacks!

● **Do not** port my mods without permission!
